actions.name: clipboard_read
actions.description: Read the current system clipboard text (auto-detects wl-paste/xclip/xsel by session); found:false when the clipboard is empty. Whatever the user last copied could be a password, token, or other secret — this can exfiltrate it.

found.description: False when the clipboard is empty.

text.description: Clipboard text (UTF-8); null when not found.

actions.name: clipboard_write
actions.description: Overwrite the system clipboard with `text` (wl-copy/xclip/xsel); replaces whatever the user currently has copied. Empty writes are rejected to avoid accidental clears.

text.description: Text to place on the clipboard (UTF-8, size-capped). Empty writes are rejected to avoid accidental clears.

actions.name: clipboard_providers
actions.description: Report the detected graphical session (wayland/x11) and which reader/writer clipboard backend binaries clipboard_read/clipboard_write would try, in order. No clipboard content is returned.

actions.name: clipboard_history
actions.description: Search/list previously copied clipboard entries persisted by this plugin (query is a case-insensitive substring filter over text; limit/offset page through results, newest first). This is a durable log, so it can surface old secrets (passwords, tokens) that have long since scrolled off the live clipboard — treat results as sensitive.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over text. Optional.

actions.name: clipboard_clear
actions.description: Permanently erase this plugin's stored clipboard history (all entries clipboard_history would return); does NOT touch the live system clipboard, only the local history log.

CLIPBOARD_PLUGIN_PROVIDER.description: Provider preference; auto detects from WAYLAND_DISPLAY/XDG_SESSION_TYPE/DISPLAY.

CLIPBOARD_PLUGIN_MAX_BYTES.description: Hard cap on clipboard payload size in bytes (default 1048576).

CLIPBOARD_PLUGIN_HISTORY.description: Set to 0/false/off/no to disable history capture. Default enabled.

CLIPBOARD_PLUGIN_HISTORY_LIMIT.description: Max history entries kept (ring, oldest evicted).
